scope.not_covered: button order, controller mapping and the SELECT+START chord already have their own gates and are not duplicated here

evidence.result_scope: host-side reading of what the firmware declares about the panel; nothing is initialized and no mode is set

image_layout.read_method: mcopy read-only at the partition offset, then unsquashfs of the declared paths; never mounted, never looped, never written

reported_order_exception.note: the firmware's own currentResolution prints width and height swapped for this board, so a reported pair is not proof of panel orientation

viewport.branch_binding: each geometry is read from the branch that defines it (board test or video-mode test), never from a loose fbset occurrence; rg34xx and rg34xx-sp share one branch in the image
viewport.hdmi_note: o rótulo hdmi-1080p define 1280x720 nesta imagem: o nome do modo não é a geometria, e o gate lê a geometria do ramo
